# netbox_custom_link (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_custom_link" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) At least one of `name` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `button_class` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `group_name` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `link_text` (String)
- `link_url` (String)
- `new_window` (Boolean)
- `object_types` (Set of String)
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `weight` (Number)
